sections.title: Hardware and Software Status
sections.content:
As of 26 April, the Illinois site had operational hardware connecting its PDP-11 system with the IMP. This report responds to RFC 116.

Trouble with the Burroughs B6500 had seriously curtailed final checkout of the PDP-11 operating system and network control program (NCP).
sections.plainLanguage: The connection hardware was working. The software still needed testing, which had been delayed by trouble with the Burroughs B6500.

sections.title: Expected Schedule
sections.content:
The report expected NCP checkout to finish by the latter part of May. It also expected the PDP-11 to be installed in Paoli, Pennsylvania, where it would provide the operating link between Illinois and the Burroughs system.

The report expected the system to be operational during June. These dates are expectations, not confirmed results.
sections.plainLanguage: The team expected to finish NCP testing by late May. It planned to install the PDP-11 in Paoli and have the system operating during June.
